places.name: Crowders Mountain State Park
places.access: Free permit at the visitor center or the access boxes. Rope climbing on the Linwood side only; bouldering at the Boulders area. Lots close when full

places.name: Linville Gorge: Shortoff Mountain
places.access: USFS. Peregrine closures on parts of Shortoff each spring-summer. Small lot fills fast. Park only on the FS end of Wolf Pit Rd; private stretch is tow-away

places.name: Linville Gorge: Table Rock
places.access: Wilderness, no permit. USFS: picnic area and lot closed after storm damage, trails open. Road gated about Jan 1-Apr 1. Watergroove area peregrine closure

places.name: Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area
places.access: Alexander County park, free, open year-round. Climb on the quarry walls; check the county for current rules
